'''Nizuc Bek''' was [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] band manager, responsible for hiring bands to play at his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Palace]]. He was also the bartender aboard [[Khetanna/Legends|Jabba's sail barge]] and would do anything for a cup of [[Juri juice/Legends|juri juice]].

==Biography==
[[File:Nizuc_bekd.jpg|thumb|left|]]
Bek was born on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. For a time he worked as a bouncer at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] and became friends with the bartender, [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]]. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] Bek came under the employment of Jabba the Hutt, accepting the proposal without regret, where he worked as a guard for visiting celebrities to Jabba's Palace, including [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] and the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]].<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>

When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited Jabba's palace to release [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Bek's [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol|DL-18 blaster pistol]] was [[Telekinesis/Legends|force pulled]] from his holster by Luke, who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to obtain it and try to defend himself.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref><ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

Nizuc Bek was aboard the ''Khetanna'' when Jabba traveled to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] to execute Skywalker and his companions.<ref name="BtM" /> The captives [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fought back]], leading to the ''Khetanna''{{'s}} destruction.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nizuc Bek first appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In the film, he was played by an uncredited actor. Despite his minimal appearance in ''Return of the Jedi'', his backstory has been fleshed out in several [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] sources, such as ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''.

In [[James Kahn]]'s [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]], the guard who falls into the pit of [[Jabba's Rancor]] is the same one [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] disarms (fulfilling the role of Bek and [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk]]) and thus gets eaten alive by the beast. The novel reveals that before getting killed, he takes his blaster to fire on the [[rancor]], to no avail and enraging it. This version of the rancor scene was actually present in the film's rough draft, describing the guard as a "man", but was changed in the final cut.<ref name="SW:TAS">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref>
